summary: Expanded the cybersecurity/software-supply-chain node into five US-listed candidates with direct or adjacent chokepoint exposure. The strongest underappreciated mappings are not only classic security platforms, but also identity/machine-identity platforms, SASE/application-edge platforms, DevSecOps orchestration, artifact/package registries, SBOM/software-composition controls, and exposure-management systems that help enterprises prove compliance and prioritize remediation as AI/cloud expands attack surfaces. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
